paragraphs: Folinic Acid is a bioavailable source of Folic Acid that helps in the production and maintenance of new cells and can be used as an alternative to Folic Acid when Folic Acid cannot be converted into its active form L-methylfolate.* Research suggests that Folinic Acid has enhanced effectiveness and bioavailability because it does not require the enzymatic conversion that Folic Acid needs to convert into L-methylfolate.*

California Gold Nutrition Folinic Acid is a bioactive form of Folate in an Alcohol-Free liquid form. Each drop contains 667 mcg DFE (which is 167% of a person’s Daily Folate Equivalent as established by the US Department of Health & Human Services).

blocks.label: Suggested use
paragraphs: Take 1 drop daily. Best when taken as directed by a qualified healthcare professional. Shake well before using.

blocks.label: Warnings
paragraphs: Keep out of reach of children. Consult with a licensed physician, pharmacist, naturopath or other qualified healthcare professional prior to taking dietary supplements.
Sealed for your protection. Do not use if seal is missing or broken. Store in a cool, dry place. Protect from heat, light, and moisture.
